title: Meet The Nur Series
bodyHtml:
Elite Italian Craftsmanship

Nur is a remarkable blend of timeless craftsmanship and contemporary design, proudly made in Civita Castellana, Italy - the ancient heart of ceramic artisanship. Nur carries forward this rich tradition with a distinctive modern flair, bringing an extraordinary aesthetic to your bathroom space.

Signature Floating Aesthetic

What sets Nur apart is its iconic curve – a visually striking feature that is incredibly challenging to achieve in ceramic form.

The design is both captivating and unique, creating an illusion of weightlessness as each piece appears to float, thanks to a subtle underskirt cleverly concealed beneath its soft bottom contours.

Versatile Range for Any Configuration

The Nur series offers endless versatility, with a diverse range of countertop, wall-hung, vanity top and column basin variations to suit any design need. Available in a contemporary colour palette, the Nur series allows you to personalise your bathroom aesthetic to perfection.

Pair your washroom basin with the elegant Nur Bath and complete the look with our Milady Series of Italian-crafted toilets to seamlessly tie together your entire scheme for a cohesive, elevated finish.

Discover Series Nur

Explore the complete Nur series today on our website, or reach out to us for a personalised consultation to find the perfect fit for your space.
